sources.title: 熊本市第8次総合計画
sources.review_boundary: The current highest-level plan and its basic-concept/basic-plan structure are verified. Vision indicators, target definitions, denominators, and page-level evidence remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 令和8年度アクションプラン
sources.review_boundary: The annually renewed action-plan layer, four fiscal 2026 priorities, detailed implementation plan, and linkage to budget formation are verified. Individual projects, indicator values, and fiscal links remain unreviewed.

sources.title: 令和6年度行政評価・総合計画検証
sources.review_boundary: The current eighth-plan administrative evaluation route, indicator list, evaluation sheets, and deliberative review are verified. Source-reported evaluation judgments are not promoted to independent achievement claims.

sources.title: 令和8年度当初予算（案）関係資料
sources.review_boundary: The official fiscal 2026 initial-budget proposal, budget book, explanatory materials, requests, and project detail are verified as proposal-stage evidence. They must not be relabeled as final enacted budget values without a canonical approval source.

sources.title: 熊本市の家計簿2025・令和6年度決算
sources.review_boundary: The fiscal 2024 settlement overview and unified-standard financial statements are verified. Account, statement, fiscal-indicator, audit, and policy-outcome records remain separate until record-level review.

unresolved_layers.boundary: The city publishes detailed official fiscal 2026 initial-budget proposal materials, and subsequent fiscal 2026 budget activity is visible, but a canonical landing that clearly establishes the enacted initial budget as the authoritative state has not yet been resolved in this inventory.

quality_boundary: This partial inventory confirms the current eighth comprehensive plan, fiscal 2026 action plan, current-plan fiscal 2024 administrative evaluation, official fiscal 2026 budget-proposal materials, and fiscal 2024 settlement. It preserves proposal-versus-enacted budget state and does not promote source evaluation judgments, indicators, projects, budget values, settlement values, or outcomes to Reviewed, linked, comparable, causal, or policy-achievement status.
next_action: Resolve the canonical enacted fiscal 2026 initial-budget source, then review action-plan projects, eighth-plan indicators and fiscal 2024 administrative evaluation evidence, fiscal 2026 budget records, and fiscal 2024 settlement records at record level while preserving source-reported evaluation judgments and budget-state boundaries.
